description_short: Local cargo shipping: ships haul products between cargo terminals on your island.
description_long:
Adds local cargo terminals and ships that haul products between them across the water of your own island.

Build local cargo terminals (all four cargo depot sizes, 2 to 8 modules) at two or more coastal spots and set their modules to offer or request products of your choice. Bigger terminals build bigger ships, and any ship can dock at any terminal — real ships with real water pathfinding, docking and crane transfers, just like the vanilla world-trade cargo ships.

Ships are built at the terminal: press the build-ship button, deliver the construction materials, and the ship enters service. Build as many ships per terminal as you like — each dock serves one ship at a time and the rest wait at anchor for their turn.

Ships sail shipping lines: create a line in the lines manager, add stops by clicking terminals and navigation buoys directly on the map, drag stops to reorder them, and assign ships — the window works just like the vanilla train lines manager. Lines have colors, and ships can be painted in their line's color.

Every stop decides when a ship may leave it: as soon as the cranes finish, or wait until the ship is loaded or unloaded to a percentage — with an optional timeout so no stop can hold a ship forever. The "Depart now" button in the ship window overrules any rule.

Ships consume fuel per journey like vanilla cargo ships and refuel at their home terminal, whose fuel buffer follows its fleet's fuel type. Refitting a ship to another fuel works from the ship window, as does "Reduce ship speed & save fuel". A ship that runs dry at sea makes a free emergency run home; a dry ship at a dock holds the berth and names the fuel it needs.

Every ship has a home port that can be reassigned from the ship window, and ships whose home terminal is demolished survive and wait for a new one. Ships you no longer need can be sold: they sail off the map and refund their build cost — scaled by the game's deconstruction refund setting — to the shipyard, like other deconstruction materials.

Navigation buoys are free, float at sea level, can be renamed, and route your lines around shallows and islands.

All of the mod's texts are translatable — see the readme in the mod's Translations folder.
